divergenceClassification.cause: validation-order difference: the shell rejects an unknown forced tier only at leg selection (swift-ci.yml:650, case arm 'Unknown tier'), which runs AFTER the main-ref override (swift-ci.yml:629) has already rewritten TIER to 'full'; the retired 'lint' tier alone is rejected early (swift-ci.yml:596-602). CI.Contract.Plan validates the forcedTier token unconditionally before any override (CI.Contract.Plan.swift:66-74, .unknownForcedTier). Consequence: forced tier outside ''|build|full|lint on GITHUB_REF refs/heads/main -> shell exits 0 planning tier=full; institute-ci exits 1 refusing the token. Identical outputs everywhere the shell refuses or the ref is not main (tags, branches, PRs).
divergenceClassification.reachability: inputs.tier is a free workflow_call string (swift-ci.yml:140-141); reachable only if a caller passes an invalid literal on a main-ref run. No known caller does (wrappers pass '' or 'full').
divergenceClassification.direction: replacement is strictly fail-closed relative to the incumbent; it can never green a run the shell would have refused
divergenceClassification.minimalReproduction: institute-ci plan --tier bogus --ref refs/heads/main --event push --lint-bundle institute -> exit 1 unknownForcedTier; same env through extracted shell -> exit 0, tier=full
